title: cubit.config/v0
description: Cubit configuration. Decoded strictly: an unknown key is an error. No environment overrides. This schema is the shape contract; cross-field checks (duplicate aliases, nested or overlapping roots, roots inside a refused prefix, two roots resolving to one real path, textfile directory filesystem) live in `cubit validate` and are listed in docs/config.md.

host.description: Slug that appears in cubit.scan/v0 only. Never read from the OS hostname. There is no host metric label.

interval.description: Time between scans in `serve`. Default 5m, plus or minus 10% jitter. `validate` rejects values under 30s.

refuse.description: Additions to the built-in refuse list (docs/refuse-list.md). The built-in entries cannot be removed.

vault.description: A vault prefix to refuse. Reported by alias only, never by path.

duration.description: Go-style duration made of integer parts, for example 30s, 5m, 1h30m.

path.description: Absolute, or relative to the invoking user's home as `~/...`.

alias.description: Appears as the `root` label and in every report. A slug, never a path. Unique across roots.

max_files.description: Per-root cap on directory entries read in one scan (each entry counts once; a stat of it is not a second count). Default 2000000 (provisional, calibrated at C1a).

max_duration.description: Per-root wall-time cap for one scan, in the grammar above (no fractions, no us or ns). Default 30s (provisional, calibrated at C1a). `validate` rejects a value at or above scan.interval. The scan document reports it as max_duration_seconds.

discovery_depth.description: How deep below the root to look for workspaces (a directory with both Cargo.toml and target/). Default 3.

max_workspaces.description: Labelled workspaces per root, largest first, ties by name. Default 64.

names.description: Relative path under the root, exactly as found on disk, to a short slug. A declared name wins over the derived label. Keys may not hold `..` or `.` components, a leading or trailing `/`, a backslash or NUL.

profiles.description: Emit the per-profile breakdown. Default true.

name.description: The workspace name for this one target dir. Defaults to the root alias.

profiles.description: Emit the per-profile breakdown. Default true.
